title: Every train in Berlin in 24 hours
description:
Every train running in Berlin on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Berlin city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: U-Bahn, S-Bahn and Regional.

Busiest moment: 294 trains at 4:59 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
